card.name: Quantifiers before 'cases' meaning sometimes
card.fires_on: Quantity words like most, many, some after 'in' (or the start of SOMETIMES in capitals) where the next words are 'cases' and the sense is 'sometimes'. Also 'and' before 'in some cases fatal'.

modes.label: In + quantifier
modes.description: The quantifier after 'In' at the start of a clause, before 'cases' or 'respects'.
modes.example: In<< many>> cases, the definitive treatment for these cancers

modes.label: Capitalized SOMETIMES
modes.description: The middle of the word SOMETIMES in an all-caps warning.
modes.example: RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION AND APNEA, S<<OMET>>IMES ASSOCIATED WITH DEATH

modes.label: And before qualifier
modes.description: The word 'and' in a list of severity terms, just before 'in some cases' or 'fatal'.
modes.example: Severe, life-threatening,<< and>> in some cases fatal hepatotoxicity,

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'sometimes' and similar hedging words, in several languages.
card.plain: It marks spots where the text is about to say something happens only some of the time, like 'in many cases'.
